go-to-bed-early.text: मैं जल्दी सो जाता / जाती हूँ
go-to-bed-early.rom: main jaldee so jaataa / jaatee hoon

notes: बजे marks the hour: सात बजे is "at seven o'clock". No word for "at" is needed.
The verb shows who is speaking: उठता / करता / जाता for a man, उठती / करती / जाती for a woman. With आप and तुम it is उठते for a man and उठती for a woman.
सो जाना ("sleep go") means to fall asleep or go to bed. Hindi often pairs a verb with जाना to show the action is completed.
